medallion_hole.why: H2 residual 1c: darker smeared patch with a ghost of the medallion/band paint in the filled medallion hole at the right shoulder; clamp tighter (25-75 %) so the ghost pattern does not survive as luminance

strip_fold.why: H2 residual 1b: stretched weave with dark dashes on the fold at the right edge of the former phantom strip (BC ladder, close_strip_az180); the dashes that stay are geometry slits of the fold (Workbench grey render), not paint

strip_top_tab.why: H2 residual 1d: gold-brown tab above the strip (paint on a raised bump, x -0.086, z 0.540-0.554); a mirror-donor box made a smeared patch larger than the tab (H2 rev. 2), recolouring keeps the texels in place

miss_fill.method: nearest valid texel of the same UV island (EDT restricted to the island); islands without a hit: nearest valid texel of the same part in 3D (POS)

residue_check.classes: sRGB HSV: grey/dark s < 0.35 or v < 0.08; gold hue 20-60, s >= 0.3, v >= 0.25; cloth = TeamMask rule

absolute_informative.note: absolute mean Y of the steel masks, render / concept; NOT the gate since H2.2 rev. 2: studio_env is brighter than the concept's light (see exposure_reference), the gate is 'relative'

baseline.local_copy: art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-KING-ARTHUR-001/20260929-h2-bake/work/h21-baseline-runtime-2k (not committed: run.py baseline_dir extracts the files with git show <commit>:<path> and checks the sha256)

change_vs_h21.class_raster: work/materials-classes-2k.png (not committed; stage textures writes it)

cobble_check.note: the plate steel on the Cobble-light K2 frames neither white (> hi, H2.1 1.27-1.51) nor black (< lo, H2.2 rev. 1 0.17-0.20); H2 0.48-0.53

steel_luminance_check.cobble_note: plate-steel pixels of the Cobble-light K2 frames (class mask of the same camera, no colour gate); share_display_max_channel_ge = share of the steel pixels whose brightest display channel reaches the threshold; steel_Y_*_over_board = steel luminance over the median luminance of the board (top 10 % rows of the frame, only board): > 1 = the steel is lighter than the grey stone board, i.e. reads light / white on the board

exposure_reference.note: informative, not the gate: the stone of the base (unchanged since H2) in the concept front vs the model front in studio_env; concept / render = how much brighter studio_env lights a diffuse material than the concept's own light; steel ratio x that factor = the steel ratio with the exposure of the concept

gate.note: sRGB HSV of the pixel: saturation <= s_max (gold trims, red cloth, brown leather out), value >= v_min (black gaps out)

steel_luminance_check.light: studio_env (the H2.1 comparison light: three suns + studio.exr)
steel_luminance_check.metric: mean relative luminance Y (Rec.709) of the sRGB-decoded pixels of the steel masks, pooled over the three ortho views
steel_luminance_check.pass_rule: relative.pooled[h22].ratio_geomean within +-0.15 of 1 AND cobble_check (steel / board in [0.4, 0.6])

red_cloth.note: concept: every pixel passing the red gate (the cloak, the tabard, the collar lining); render: the red-cloth class x the same gate

stone.note: the vertical face of the base (concept: rectangle inside the face; render: the stone class, eroded)

relative.what: H2.2 rev. 2 gate (2026-09-29): steel luminance relative to reference materials of the same frame (stone of the base, red cloth, gold; the steel pass does not change them), concept vs render: ratio_r = (Y_steel / Y_r)_render / (Y_steel / Y_r)_concept; gate = geometric mean over the references, pooled over front/side/back, within +-tolerance of 1. Why: H2.2 rev. 1 matched the ABSOLUTE mean Y in studio_env, which lights the unchanged stone x2.1 brighter than the concept's own light, so the steel came out ~2x too dark next to the other materials (review: 'black lacquer' instead of the concept's dark grey blued steel). Gold is not a reference: the material pass of H2.1 made it a metal (it reflects the environment like the steel and differs from the concept gold: concept hue 30 / saturation 0.51, render hue 40 / saturation 0.37), and it is not unchanged since H2

team_mask.edge: normalised Gaussian inside the cloth parts' coverage + nearest covered texel fill

edge_check.method: 2K runtime TeamMask.R and its 2x2 box mips 1-3; sample points = atlas texel centres (same UV)

rule.cloth_parts_note: cloak, front tabard and the torso part (its red collar/cloak lining only, through the colour rule); pauldrons are excluded (their red texels are cloak bleed of the Tripo texture)
rule.edge: soft edge = normalised Gaussian inside the cloth parts' coverage (gauss(cloth * cov) / gauss(cov)), then the gutters and the empty atlas take the nearest covered texel like BC; the first build blurred over the empty gutter and cut at the bake margin, so the edge row of the cloth islands fell to R 0.60 (interior 0.93) and a TeamDye render showed red hairlines on the cloak seams (review 2026-09-29)
rule.format: RGBA 8-bit linear: R = cloth (TeamColor on clothing, user decision U-3 / AD-CNF-58 = b), G = base band (side wall of the base), B = 0, A = 255. Wave 4 proposal: 1-channel TeamMask read as .R by M_UM_Figure (TC_Grayscale) - compatible; the base band G is an input for M_UM_BaseMarker only if wave 4 adopts it (it currently uses a vertex mask R / side-wall normal)
rule.rule_note: measured on the baked BC (4K, hit texels): cloak red hue 330-15 deg, s p10/p50/p90 0.70/0.75/0.79, v p5/p95 0.32/0.46; gold embroidery hue 20-55 deg stays out of the mask
